scenario: Migrate a FHIR R4 MedicationRequest to a valid FHIR R5 MedicationRequest, applying the breaking structural changes of the R5 spec.
instruction: The resource below is FHIR R4. Migrate it to a valid FHIR R5 MedicationRequest, applying the structural changes the R5 specification introduced — for example, the R4 choice element medication[x] (medicationCodeableConcept / medicationReference) was replaced in R5 by a single 'medication' element of type CodeableReference. Preserve all clinical content unchanged (codes, status, intent, subject, dates, dosage). Respond with only the JSON object {"resource": { ... }}.
